修.meaning: A <part>fan seller</part> with long white <part>whiskers</part> makes his apprentice fold one paper fan a day, perfectly, for ten years. No breaks, no sweets, no grumbling. In the end the boy can fold one blindfolded in the dark. That's <kanji>discipline</kanji>.
修.on: Then he must balance each fan on the tip of a giant <sound>shoe</sound>.
修.kun: '<sound>Oh</sound>,' sighs the master, handing him a thick <sound>sa</sound>ga to study next.

件.meaning: A <part>cow</part> wanders into a lawyer's office and hangs her bell on the <part>coat hook</part>. She's come about the missing hay. The lawyer opens a fat folder and licks her pencil: this is a serious <kanji>affair</kanji>.
件.on: The main suspect is the dog in the <sound>ken</sound>nel next door.
件.kun: A <sound>cu</sound>ckoo pops out of the office clock and points at the <sound>dun</sound>geon key in the dog's mouth.

撃.meaning: A <part>maiden</part> in a flowing gown sees a toy <part>car</part> zoom straight at her cat. She raises one <part>hand</part>, chops the bonnet, and the car flips three times into the flowerbed. She can <kanji>beat</kanji> anything on wheels.
撃.on: A <sound>gec</sound>ko on the garden wall claps its sticky feet.
撃.kun: '<sound>Oo</sound>ps,' she says, dusting off her hand and tossing the car into the bin.

射.meaning: A golfer with a huge <part>pot belly</part> can't see the ball past his tummy, so he props the <part>golf club</part> on top of it like a cannon and fires the ball off his belly button. It whistles into the hole from a mile away. Nobody else can <kanji>shoot</kanji> like that.
射.on: Next he fires a <sound>shu</sound>ttlecock the same way, feathers first.
射.kun: It knocks an <sound>ee</sound>l clean out of the water hazard.

証.meaning: A parrot in court gives a <part>speech</part>, repeating word for word what the burglar said on the night. Every word is <part>correct</part>, down to the burp at the end. The judge bangs her gavel: the parrot is the best <kanji>evidence</kanji>.
証.on: The trial turns into a <sound>show</sound>, with the parrot taking bows.
証.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>!' gasps a <sound>ca</sound>rp in the court fish tank, ducking behind a tiny <sound>shi</sound>eld.

船.meaning: A little rowing <part>boat</part> drinks a whole bottle of growing tonic through a <part>funnel</part>. Overnight it stretches, sprouts decks, cabins and a smoking chimney, and blasts its horn at the harbour. That dinghy is now a huge <kanji>ship</kanji>.
船.on: A <sound>sen</sound>try now marches up and down its deck day and night.
船.kun: The captain naps on a <sound>fu</sound>ton below deck with a fishing <sound>ne</sound>t over his face.

管.meaning: A <part>bureaucrat</part> wants water in his office, so he fills out forty forms, waits a year, and gets one hollow stick of <part>bamboo</part> poked through his window. A trickle runs down it into his teacup. At last, his very own <kanji>pipe</kanji>.
管.on: He pops a pink <sound>car</sound>nation into the end as a little vase.
管.kun: A <sound>cu</sound>ckoo pops out of the far end of the pipe: 'Ta-<sound>da</sound>!'

余.meaning: Under a big beach <part>umbrella</part>, a gull keeps dropping fish onto a little stone <part>altar</part> in the sand, an offering for the sun. Ten fish, twenty, a hundred, until the altar tips over and they all slide back out to sea. Even the sun thinks that's <kanji>too much</kanji>.
余.on: The next day he brings just one small pot of <sound>yo</sound>gurt instead.
余.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>, <sound>ma</sound>ma,' sighs his chick, 'all the leftovers are for me!'
